description: My personal portfolio website showcasing technical skills, education, projects and responsive web development expertise.

paragraphs: A modern, fully responsive, and production-ready personal portfolio website showcasing my projects, technical skills, education, certifications, and professional journey. Built with HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript, it emphasizes clean design, responsive layouts, performance optimization, accessibility, and SEO best practices.
This portfolio website serves as my professional digital presence, showcasing my skills, projects, education, certifications, and development journey as a Frontend Web Developer.

Built using HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript, the portfolio follows modern frontend development practices with a strong emphasis on responsive design, clean architecture, accessibility, performance optimization, and search engine optimization (SEO).
features: 👨‍💻 Professional personal portfolio with a modern and intuitive user interface
🏠 Interactive landing page with hero section and smooth navigation
🙋 Dedicated About Me section highlighting my background, career goals, and professional journey
🛠️ Technical Skills section showcasing programming languages, frameworks, tools, and technologies
🚀 Featured Projects section with live demos, GitHub repositories, and technology stacks
